# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-09-08
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Early session volume bias predicts continuation of breakout direction from the opening range. When the 30-minute opening range high is broken with significant buying pressure (up-volume exceeding down-volume by 20%+) and price closes above VWAP, it indicates institutional participation favoring upward continuation.

## Mechanism

Entry: At 09:30-10:30 ET, if the current bar breaks above the 30-minute opening range high, up-volume/down-volume ratio >= 1.2, and close > VWAP, enter long at bar close. Exit: Initial stop at opening range low. Profit target at 1.5R (risk = entry - stop). After achieving 1R profit, switch to chandelier trail (2.5x ATR(20)) to capture extended moves. Regime filters: Only trade when VIX < 15 and ADX > 15 to avoid choppy conditions.
